environment_setting: Country B, Capital City, where senior government employees often transition to private sector roles after leaving public service.
norm_base: Senior government employees Communicating with intent to influence former agency within 1 year of leaving Fine and/or penalties under §216

character_profile.name: John Smith
character_profile.goal: Secure a lucrative consulting contract with a private firm

legitimate.legitimate_action: Avoid contacting former agency and focus on building relationships outside the restricted scope.
legitimate.benefits: Maintains legal compliance, avoids penalties, builds a long-term reputation.
legitimate.costs: Slower progress in securing contracts, limited access to former agency's resources.

illegal.illegal_action: Communicate with former agency to influence decisions favoring a private firm.
illegal.benefits: Faster contract acquisition, potential for higher financial rewards.
illegal.costs: Fine and/or penalties under §216, damage to reputation if discovered.

legitimate.legitimate_action: Advise John Smith to avoid any communication with his former agency.
legitimate.benefits: Ensures compliance, avoids legal risks for both parties.
legitimate.costs: May strain professional relationship with John Smith.

illegal.illegal_action: Ignore John Smith's potential violation and allow him to proceed.
illegal.benefits: Maintains a positive relationship with John Smith, avoids confrontation.
illegal.costs: Risk of penalties if discovered, damage to professional reputation.

character_profile.name: Michael Lee
character_profile.profession: CEO of a Private Consulting Firm
character_profile.goal: Secure government contracts for his firm

legitimate.legitimate_action: Encourage John Smith to use his expertise without violating post-employment restrictions.
legitimate.benefits: Avoids legal risks, builds a sustainable business relationship.
legitimate.costs: Slower progress in securing government contracts.
